_doc: Every deliberate pin in this repo. Read the `pins` skill before editing. A pin must have a reason, a review deadline within max_review_days of the last review, and a probe or a manual_test. Moving review_by forward means you re-tested it and wrote down what you found in `review_note`.

pins.review_note: 2026-11-18: probe fails against nixos-unstable 04906337 (2026-11-17), now for a different reason: it ships Ghidra 12.2 with JDK 21, and rea doctor accepts only Ghidra 12.1.x and JDK 25+, so the check stops before the decompiler runs. The segfault cannot be re-tested on a current rev until REA accepts 12.2 or the overlay pins Ghidra 12.1.x. Keep the pin.
pins.reason: On nixpkgs_unstable from 02c087f3 (2026-10-23) Ghidra's native decompile helper segfaults on startup (exit 139), so rea-ghidra fails and every nightly lock PR is blocked. Bisected to the nixpkgs_unstable bump alone; Ghidra, JDK and rea versions are unchanged. Not a Ghidra version problem: 12.1.2 fails on the new rev, 12.1.4 passes on the old one.
pins.removal: Delete the input, the rea-toolchain attribute in overlays/default.nix, and point home/programs/rea/ghidra.nix back at pkgs.unstable. Or move the rev forward if a newer rev passes.
pins.upstream: https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs (no issue filed yet; file one with the glibc 2.44-57 segfault)

pins.reason: Kept as a rev pin, not branch-following, so a kernel bump is a reviewed change. Moved from f5e1fb8f (7.3.4) to c157f8dd (7.3.5; master and release heads on 2026-11-18). Upstream 9d100180 now forces RUST off for LTO when pahole < 1.33 and leaves DEBUG_INFO_BTF on (earlier it forced BTF off, nix-cachyos-kernel#115). modules/base overlays cachyos-lto-btf sets both DEBUG_INFO_BTF and RUST on for the LTO zen4 kernel with CachyOS's pahole patches (patches/pahole); checked in the ali-desktop configfile (CONFIG_RUST=y, CONFIG_DEBUG_INFO_BTF=y). That build is not on cache.lantian.pub; hosts build it from source until it is pushed to our niks3 cache.
pins.removal: Bump to the current upstream master rev when the probe says one exists.

cmd: test "$(nix flake metadata --json github:xddxdd/nix-cachyos-kernel/master | jq -r .locked.rev)" != c157f8ddd2c830e8dd5ef6cf11a288668fb96189

pins.reason: Must match the niks3 server running in aws-k3s. Server v1.6.1 switched small NARs to single-PUT presigned URLs; clients older than 1.6.1 reject that with 'NAR files should use multipart upload'. Client and server API drift gives 404s.
pins.removal: Bump together with the aws-k3s niks3 server image (home-cluster repo), never alone.

pins.reason: Version selected when the repo moved to the dendritic layout (13982132). A tagged release is a deliberate choice, not a workaround; the registry entry exists so it is reviewed on a schedule.
pins.removal: Bump when a newer release exists and `just check` passes.

pins.reason: Pinned to the v0.6.0 release in 420737e3 ('Fix KVM VMs'). The commit does not say why a later release is unsuitable, so treat this as unverified until someone tries.
pins.removal: Bump when a newer release exists and the KVM hypervisor host still builds.

pins.pinned: FFmpeg master 19c06936 (2026-10-23) used for citron and zen-browser
pins.reason: No ffmpeg release has the fixes for the CVEs vulnix reports on 9.0.2 and 8.1.x: the NVD texts read "through 9.0.2" and "before 9.0", and the five fix commits they cite (4da9812, 5d7112c, 8670835, aafb5c6, b506faf) are in master but in no release. blender (5.1.1, ffmpeg 7), makemkv (2.0.0, ffmpeg 8) and lutris (FHS ffmpeg 6) cannot take master: it removed AVCodec::sample_fmts, ch_layouts and supported_samplerates, which blender's audaspace and makemkv's libffabi use, so they stay on vulnerable releases.
pins.removal: Delete pkgs/ffmpeg-git, the ffmpeg-git and ffmpeg-git-unstable entries in pkgs/default.nix, the citron ffmpeg argument and the zen-browser unwrappedPackage override, then rescan with vulnix -C.

pins.reason: nixpkgs master carried claude-code 2.1.319 or older while Anthropic had published 2.1.327 (downloads.claude.ai, 2026-11-18); the overlay feeds the upstream package Anthropic's own manifest.zst.json to run ahead of master.
pins.removal: Delete pkgs/claude-code, restore `inherit (final.master) claude-code;` in overlays/default.nix, then run nix flake update nixpkgs_master.

pins.pinned: nginx 1.30.7 tarball on download-server-1 over nixpkgs' 1.30.6
pins.reason: nginx 1.30.6, which the locked nixpkgs ships, is affected by the HTTP/2 flow-control overflow CVE-2026-123007 and the HTTP/2 use-after-free CVE-2026-123633 (https://nginx.org/en/security_advisories.html). 1.30.7 fixes both; nixpkgs master has it but nixos-unstable did not on 2026-11-19, and download-server-1 serves HTTPS with HTTP/2 on.
pins.removal: Delete the services.nginx.package override and its comment in flake-modules/hosts/download-server-1/default.nix, delete this entry, then build download-server-1 and check services.nginx.package.version is 1.30.7 or later.

pins.reason: The 2026-11-23 nixpkgs bump marks keybase-gui-6.5.1 insecure (knownVulnerabilities: "EOL vendored Electron 39.2.7"), so ali-desktop failed to evaluate via modules/desktop-base and home/autostart. Accepted risk: keep the Keybase GUI working until upstream ships a build on a supported Electron.
pins.removal: Delete the nixpkgs.config.permittedInsecurePackages line and its comments in modules/desktop-base/default.nix, delete this entry, then build ali-desktop. If keybase-gui is still insecure, drop keybase-gui from modules/desktop-base and home/programs/keybase and the keybase autostart entry in home/autostart instead.

pins.pinned: Eclipse Temurin JRE 21.0.13.1+2 for the Minecraft server images (Arkana + Aeronautics, Create: Sky Colonies)
pins.reason: CVE-2026-114938 ("Java4Shell", CVSS 8.1): memory corruption in the OpenJDK Base64 decoder intrinsic on x86-64 CPUs with AVX-512 VBMI allows pre-auth RCE where untrusted input is Base64-decoded; affects OpenJDK 17.0.6 and later. Fixed in 21.0.13.1 (Red Hat RHSA-2026:100569, Debian openjdk-21 21.0.13.1+2-1~deb13u1, Temurin jdk-21.0.13.1+2 released 2026-11-18). The locked nixos-26.05 (0dc498bf) ships temurin-jre-bin-21 21.0.11 and nixos-unstable (2786a2a7) 21.0.12.1, both vulnerable. Sources: https://www.openwall.com/lists/oss-security/2026/11/17/31 https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-114938 https://bugzilla.redhat.com/show_bug.cgi?id=2574227
pins.removal: In flake-modules/minecraft-images.nix set `jre = pkgs.temurin-jre-bin-21;` again (delete the overrideAttrs block), confirm nixpkgs' pkgs/development/compilers/temurin-bin/sources.json URL for openjdk21 jre is jdk-21.0.13.1 or newer, rebuild both images and cut a new image tag.
pins.review_note: Probe asks for 21.0.14 rather than 21.0.13.1 because nixpkgs reports 21.0.x.1 respins as plain 21.0.x (21.0.12.1 shows as 21.0.12), so 21.0.13 cannot tell the fixed respin from the vulnerable 21.0.13+9. Drop earlier by hand if sources.json already points at jdk-21.0.13.1.
